summary: A right drawer, 400px wide, listing four notifications with unread dots and timestamps.
use: A notifications panel opened from a header bell button.
spec: `const items` has four entries with fields `title`, `body`, `time` and `unread`, two unread
Rows rendered with `{#each items as n}` and `class:notif--unread={n.unread}`; unread rows show `<span class="dot">`
`{#snippet actions()}` holds `<Button variant="ghost" size="sm"` labelled Mark all read
Trigger is `<Button variant="ghost"` with a `<Bell size={14} />` icon
